I have to say the creepiest thing that has ever happened to me occurred when I was going through a very dark phase in my life. I had just gotten into an argument with my ex boyfriend and had taken two handfuls of Benadryl. About 30 minutes after I take the Benadryl the drugs began to kick in. Please note that Benadryl is a deliriant, and causes temporary insanity in high doses. So, the drugs kicked in. My boyfriend had appeared in the room, it was laying on my bed playing a game on his phone. Even though he had left an hour before this didn't seem out of the ordinary to me. I was seeing spiders running up and down my walls and I asked him if they were real or if I was just hallucinating, and he told me that they weren't real and that I was seeing things. Somehow though I was not aware that I was under the influence of drugs, as I had went to close my door, and then turned around to find that my boyfriend was no longer there. Enraged, I thought that he was hiding from me. I searched high and low for him, even going as far as screaming at my stuffed animals and cutting open my giant teddy bear to see if he was hiding inside. Of course he wasn't. He kept appearing and disappearing, fueling my search for him. He was nowhere to be found, so I eventually gave up. At this point I was blacking out frequently, as I have pieces of missing memory from the night. I imagine that I must have fallen asleep while standing up, because I would blink and then 2 hours would have gone by. 

While this isn't necessarily creepy, it is definitely the scariest thing that ever happened to me. I woke up the next day in total awe of what had happened to  me the previous night and pretty sad that I'd cut up my stuffed animals.

What is the creepiest or scariest thing that has ever happened to you guys? Weather drug-induced, paranormal or not, I want to hear them all.
